tasks.title: Protect Jarvis-board main branch
tasks.description:
Blocked on GitHub UI/admin. Proposed branch protection for `main` (Jarvis-board):

Branch protection rule: `main`
- Require a pull request before merging (✅)
  - Required approvals: 1
  - Dismiss stale approvals when new commits are pushed (✅)
  - Require review from Code Owners (optional; only if CODEOWNERS exists)
- Require status checks to pass before merging (✅)
  - CI (from .github/workflows/ci.yml)
  - CodeQL (from .github/workflows/codeql.yml)
- Require conversation resolution before merging (✅)
- Require signed commits (optional)
- Require linear history (optional)
- Do not allow bypassing the above settings (✅)
- Restrict who can push to matching branches (optional; can leave off for now)
- Allow force pushes / deletions (❌)

Test after enabling:
1) Try direct push to main → should be blocked
2) Open PR from branch → checks run, merge allowed only after green checks + approval.

tasks.title: Sprint 2026-02-06 (Fri): GitHub hardening doc + security snapshot
tasks.description:
#1 objective (today): Ship the repo-hardening checklist doc + the gh-based security snapshot script so Orazio can flip all GitHub security + branch protection settings in <5 minutes.

PR-sized tasks (Jarvis):
1) Finish **docs/repo-hardening.md** in jarvis-board with exact clickpath toggles (Dependabot alerts/updates, secret scanning, code scanning, branch protection).
2) Implement **scripts/gh-security-snapshot** (bash/node) that prints: branch protection status + required checks + security features enabled + TODO checklist.

Exact test prompts/steps:
- Local doc check: open docs/repo-hardening.md, verify it includes: Settings → Security & analysis toggles + Branches → Branch protection rule fields + which checks to select (CI, CodeQL).
- Script run (jarvis-board):
  1) cd jarvis-board
  2) gh auth status
  3) ./scripts/gh-security-snapshot.sh OrazioP26/jarvis-board (or node variant)
  4) Confirm output includes: protection rule exists?; required checks names; dependabot_alerts on/off; secret_scanning on/off; code_scanning on/off.
- Script run (optional second repo): ./scripts/gh-security-snapshot.sh OrazioP26/novl-api to ensure it handles repos without protection rules gracefully.

Blockers + decisions needed:
- Needs Orazio GitHub admin clicks for: enabling security toggles + creating branch protection rule (task: “Flip GitHub settings…”).
- Decision: do we enforce PR-required on main (even for Jarvis-board) once CI+CodeQL are stable? (recommended yes).
